content: {"reasoning":"The required authorization is missing, and the payer’s 30-day retroactive authorization window is closed, so another retro-auth request would violate published rules. The CO-197 denial supports a formal appeal, while peer-to-peer is unavailable and an unchanged resubmission would not cure the authorization defect. An appeal with medical-necessity documentation is the only available payer action that can properly progress the claim.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
